question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown. Which number will be on the page opposite to 6?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8adba974504158fb90679a71facac67d768992cb53204b3eb3257b770512535.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 3 is common on both the dices, it is clear that 1, 6, 2, and 5 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 4 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/218b4f65ed2445faa925a073305e224750ed1d168032661082055c393365357e.png] 

Opposite pairs:

6 → 5

1 → 2

3 → 4

So, the opposite side of "6" will be side "5".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
